title: Frontic UI registry item manifest
description: One registry item's manifest: in the registry's source, where the build derives its files and dependencies; in a project, beside the component's files, where `add` writes it; and as a stack stores an item. A component's manifest holds the recipe trees it owns. A stored item carries type and may leave out title and description; an authored manifest holds both and no top-level composes.

name.description: The item's name; when present it must equal the folder the manifest sits in, which names the item.

recipes.description: The trees this item owns, by name; each is a recipe as https://registry.ui.frontic.com/recipe.schema.json describes it, and lists in composes the shared recipes its element wears. A tree may hold only composes; an element with no tree of its own answers to the item's root tree.

composes.description: Never authored: a registry source or project manifest lists what each tree's element wears in that tree's own composes. An item stored by a Frontic account, which carries type, may still hold this top-level list until the account's library is migrated; composesOf reads both.

type.description: The item's registry type, such as registry:ui; a stack's stored item carries it.

files.description: The item's files; a stack's stored item carries them.

dependencies.description: The npm packages the item's files import.

devDependencies.description: The npm packages the item needs at build time.

registryDependencies.description: The registry items the item's files import.

meta.description: A stack's own data on a stored item.

props.description: The item's props, as the stack reads them.

source.description: Where the stored item came from.
